title: Daily Liga Collection Scan
summary: Approve F67: Daily Liga Collection Scan. Three-part feature: (1) scheduled admin_daily_liga APScheduler cron job at 6AM scanning all admin collections via Liga with zero credit cost, (2) per-card credit cost for non-admin bulk Refresh All replacing flat BULK_SCAN_COST=5, (3) max_age_days filter to skip recently-scanned cards in bulk refresh.

rationale.alignment: High. Daily automated scans keep price data fresh without manual intervention. Per-card credit cost is fairer than flat-rate (a user with 10 cards should pay less than one with 300). max_age_days avoids redundant scraping, reducing Liga load and saving credits.
rationale.feasibility: High. All building blocks exist: APScheduler (F37), Liga scan orchestrator (F60 liga_scan.py), credit system (F65), max_age_days already accepted by run_scan/run_liga_scan/get_cards_for_liga_scan. The feature is integration work, not greenfield.
rationale.risk: Low-Medium. Main risk is Liga rate limiting on large collections (mitigated by existing concurrency=1, 5s delay, max_age_days skip). Credit model change (flat→per-card) needs frontend confirmation modal update but is straightforward.
rationale.complexity: Medium. ~6-8 tasks across backend and frontend. No new dependencies.

existing_infrastructure.scheduler: ScanScheduler (src/scheduler/service.py) already manages APScheduler lifecycle, cron triggers, auto-pause on failure. seed_default_liga_schedules() in repo already seeds schedules at startup.
existing_infrastructure.liga_scan: run_liga_scan (src/collectors/liga_scan.py) wraps run_scan with Liga provider. Already accepts max_age_days parameter.
existing_infrastructure.credit_system: CreditService (src/credits/service.py) with check/deduct/grant. Admin bypass at router level. BULK_SCAN_COST=5 flat in constants.py.
existing_infrastructure.scan_trigger: POST /scans endpoint (src/api/routers/scans.py) deducts BULK_SCAN_COST before launching async scan. Frontend useCollectionRefresh triggers via triggerScanAuth.
existing_infrastructure.max_age_days: Already plumbed through run_scan→get_cards_for_liga_scan but NOT exposed in POST /scans API endpoint or frontend.

backend: Add admin_daily_liga job registration in ScanScheduler.start() or via seed_default_liga_schedules — a system-level cron (0 6 * * *) that queries admin users and runs Liga scan for their collections, no credit deduction.

Change credit model in POST /scans: replace flat BULK_SCAN_COST with per-card cost (1 credit per card). Need to know card count BEFORE deducting — query get_cards_for_liga_scan count first, then deduct.
Expose max_age_days in ScanRequest schema and POST /scans handler, pass through to run_liga_scan.
New collector function or scheduler callback: admin_daily_liga_scan that fetches admin user IDs from DB, runs Liga scan for each admin's collection with max_age_days=1 (skip cards scanned today).
frontend: Update CreditConfirmModal to show per-card cost (fetch card count first via new endpoint or include in scan preview).
Add max_age_days option to Refresh All (default 1 day — skip cards refreshed today).
Update useCollectionRefresh to pass max_age_days parameter.

wave_0.title: Per-card credit cost for bulk scan
wave_0.description: Replace BULK_SCAN_COST=5 flat with per-card cost (1 credit/card). Add GET /scans/preview endpoint returning {card_count, credit_cost} for the authenticated user's collection (respects max_age_days). Update POST /scans to compute cost from card count, deduct per-card. Add PER_CARD_SCAN_COST=1 constant.

wave_0.title: Expose max_age_days in scan API
wave_0.description: Add max_age_days field to ScanRequest schema (optional int, default None). Pass through POST /scans handler to run_liga_scan. Include in scan preview endpoint.

wave_1.title: Admin daily Liga scan job
wave_1.description: Create admin_daily_liga_scan function in src/collectors/ that: queries all admin users, gets their collection entries, runs run_liga_scan with max_age_days=1 and no credit deduction. Register as system cron job (0 6 * * *) in ScanScheduler.start() — NOT a user schedule, a hardcoded system job. Log results.

wave_1.title: Frontend per-card cost confirmation
wave_1.description: Before Refresh All, call GET /scans/preview to get card_count and credit_cost. Update CreditConfirmModal to show 'Refreshing N cards will cost N treasure tokens'. If max_age_days reduces count, show that too. Admin sees 'Free (admin bypass)'.

wave_2.title: Frontend max_age_days option
wave_2.description: Add 'Skip recently scanned' toggle or dropdown (1d/3d/7d/none) to Refresh All UI. Default 1 day. Pass to triggerScanAuth and scan preview. i18n keys.

wave_2.title: Tests and integration validation
wave_2.description: Backend: unit tests for per-card cost logic, preview endpoint, admin daily scan function, max_age_days passthrough. Frontend: tests for updated CreditConfirmModal, preview fetch, max_age_days selector.

key_decisions.decision: Per-card cost = 1 credit (same as single refresh)
key_decisions.rationale: Consistent pricing: refreshing 1 card costs 1 credit whether done individually or in bulk. No bulk discount — keeps the economy simple.

key_decisions.decision: Admin daily scan is a system job, not a user-created schedule
key_decisions.rationale: Avoids cluttering the user's schedule list. System jobs are managed by the platform, not deletable by users. Hardcoded in scheduler startup.

key_decisions.decision: Default max_age_days=1 for daily scan, configurable for manual Refresh All
key_decisions.rationale: Daily scan should skip cards already scanned today. Manual refresh gives user control (1d/3d/7d/none).
Per-card cost requires knowing the count BEFORE charging. Preview endpoint also enables better UX — user sees exactly how many cards and how many credits before confirming.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Large admin collections overwhelm Liga at 6AM
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: max_age_days=1 skips recently scanned. Liga concurrency=1, 5s delay already enforced. If collection is 300+ cards, scan takes ~25 minutes — acceptable for background job.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Multiple admin users cause overlapping scans
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Run admin scans sequentially (one after another), not in parallel. ScanScheduler already has concurrency guard (skip if previous running).

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Per-card cost breaks existing frontend flow
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Preview endpoint provides the cost; CreditConfirmModal already exists. Just update the displayed amount.

estimated_effort.backend_files_changed: ~8 (constants, scans router, scan schemas, scheduler service, new collector fn, repository, tests)
estimated_effort.frontend_files_changed: ~6 (scans API, useCollectionRefresh, CreditConfirmModal, MyCollection, i18n, tests)
